description: This file defines the StandardSessionConnection class for managing session data storage in DynamoDB within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for reading, writing, deleting, and cleaning up expired session items, utilizing DynamoDB API calls.

classes.name: StandardSessionConnection
classes.description: Implements session storage operations using AWS DynamoDB, including reading, writing, deleting, and cleaning expired sessions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the session connection with a DynamoDbClient instance and configuration.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves session data associated with the given session ID from DynamoDB.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores or updates session data in DynamoDB with optional expiration handling.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the session data for the specified session ID from DynamoDB.

methods.name: deleteExpired
methods.description: Deletes all expired session items from DynamoDB based on their TTL attribute.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Formats the session ID into a DynamoDB key structure.

methods.name: triggerError
methods.description: Triggers a PHP warning for errors encountered during DynamoDB operations.
